Descripción de la empresa 




Leonardo Neve Design Group es una empresa de arquitectura que diseña para un futuro mejor, poniendo énfasis en la importancia de los espacios que habitas. Nos centramos en soluciones innovadoras, humanas y positivas para proyectos de uso mixto, educativos, comerciales y residenciales. 

Hemos desarrollado más de 200 proyectos arquitectónicos en Latinoamérica y Estados Unidos. Nuestro equipo directivo forma parte del American Institute of Architecture (IAIA), reforzando nuestro compromiso con la excelencia profesional.




Descripción del puesto 




Como Marketing Digital Intern en Leonardo Neve Design Group, apoyarás en la creación y gestión de contenidos para redes sociales, web y campañas digitales, alineados con la identidad de la empresa. Participarás en la planificación de estrategias de marketing, seguimiento de métricas y elaboración de informes básicos de rendimiento. 

También colaborarás en la coordinación de campañas y acciones de comunicación orientadas a posicionar nuestros proyectos arquitectónicos y fortalecer la marca. Este puesto es una práctica de marketing digital y se realiza en modalidad remota, con colaboración diaria con el equipo creativo y de arquitectura.




Requisitos

Aptitudes digitales: interés y conocimientos básicos en redes sociales, marketing de contenidos y gestión de comunidades online.
Aptitudes de análisis: capacidad para interpretar datos sencillos de campañas digitales, métricas de redes sociales y comportamiento de usuarios.

description:
¿Quiénes somos? 




Clivi es la primera startup en México enfocada en mejorar la vida de personas con enfermedades crónicas como diabetes, sobrepeso y obesidad, las principales causas de muerte en México y Latinoamérica.




Somos la empresa de salud digital de mayor crecimiento en México: hemos atendido a más de 17 mil pacientes. Fuimos la primera compañía digital en México en trabajar con los dos titanes del GLP-1 en el mundo. Nuestra misión es simple pero poderosa: llevar salud de calidad a quienes más lo necesitan.




La posición 




No buscamos un perfil. Buscamos solo a alguien extraordinari@.




Te vamos a dar problemas reales del negocio, no tareas. Un funnel que no convierte. Un canal que nadie ha probado, una línea de negocio que lanzar, etc.. Un proceso manual que se come 40 horas a la semana del equipo. Tu trabajo es entender el problema, construir la solución (con código, con IA, con lo que haga falta) y medir si funcionó. Luego el siguiente.




Serás un builder: un mes estarás automatizando el seguimiento de leads con agentes de IA, el siguiente lanzando un experimento de adquisición, el siguiente construyendo el dashboard de automatizado de una nueva línea de negocio que tú mismo@ lanzaste. Trabajarás directamente con los fundadores.




¿Qué harás con nosotros? 




Tomar proyectos de growth de principio a fin: diagnóstico, solución, lanzamiento y medición.
Construir herramientas internas, automatizaciones y agentes de IA que hagan que el equipo se mueva 10x más rápido.

Construiste algo real. Una app, un bot, una herramienta, un negocio, un proyecto open source. Algo que otras personas usaron, que generó dinero o que resolvió un problema real. Muéstranos el link, el repo o los números. Este es el requisito más importante.

Tiene ambición para ganar, y ganas de construir la compañía de salud digital más grande de LATAM. (competir y ganar)

Suma puntos

Ya emprendiste, aunque haya fracasado. Sobre todo si fracasó y sabes por qué.
Tienes seguidores, usuarios o clientes que puedes nombrar.




Esto no es para todos 




Seremos honestos: esto no es un trabajo de 9 a 6. Trabajamos con intensidad de fundador. Hay semanas largas y fines de semana en los que un lanzamiento no puede esperar. Buscamos gente que quiera estar en la oficina porque ahí está la acción, que se obsesione con sus proyectos y que no pueda dormir hasta resolverlos. Si buscas comodidad, este no es tu lugar. Si buscas aprender en 2 años lo que otros aprenden en 10, sí.

Performance Analysis & Reporting

You’re going to fix that.

UJV is a service-driven team of experts that work behind the scenes, engineering luxury travel experiences for advisors globally, so they can grow their business and fully satisfy their exclusive clients.

We are the luxury travel advisor’s right hand. How?


UJV is a team of travel experts that advises and supports luxury travel advisors worldwide.
We work behind the scenes as allies of top luxury travel advisors, to offer a 5 Star experience for their clients.
We offer travel advisors the knowledge and tools needed to grow their business and better serve their exclusive clients.
We offer an experience-centered service based on passion, expertise, integrity
and attention to detail.
We are willing to do the hard work in order to see our clients shine.


Role Mission

At Ultimate Jet Vacations, email is more than a channel, it’s one of our most powerful revenue engines. It’s how we nurture travelers from first click to confirmed booking, and how we keep them coming back.

We’re looking for an Email Marketing Specialist who will own the strategy, execution, and performance of our email programs in HubSpot. You’ll design campaigns and automated journeys that grow our subscriber base, deepen engagement, and consistently drive revenue, with a goal of generating at least USD 5 million annually through email.

This role goes beyond sending campaigns. You’ll be a HubSpot system expert, a data-driven optimizer, and a creative storyteller, turning insights into smarter campaigns and measurable business results.

Responsibilities

Lifecycle & CRM Strategy

You will own and evolve UJV’s CRM ecosystem within HubSpot, building scalable segmentation and lifecycle strategies that move advisors from new leads to highly engaged, high-value partners. You’ll continuously improve audience targeting, engagement scoring, and database health to maximize conversion opportunities.

Email Marketing & Campaign Execution

You will build and execute high-performing email campaigns across nurture flows, co-op campaigns, re-engagement sequences, and conversion-focused initiatives. You understand how to balance strategy with flawless execution, ensuring campaigns are timely, relevant, and aligned with business priorities.

Segmentation & Personalization

You will develop sophisticated segmentation strategies based on advisor behavior, engagement history, booking trends, and destination interests. You know personalization goes beyond “first name” tokens, and you understand how to make every campaign feel intentional and relevant.

Automation & Funnel Development

You will create scalable automated workflows that support long-term growth, including onboarding journeys, nurture sequences, re-engagement campaigns, and conversion funnels. You think beyond one-off sends and build systems that continuously move advisors through the lifecycle.

Performance, Optimization & AI-Powered Growth

You will own email performance reporting and optimization, tracking metrics such as engagement, conversion, pipeline contribution, and campaign ROI. You’re naturally analytical and constantly testing, iterating, and improving. We leverage AI to move faster, and you’ll use AI-powered tools to improve targeting, messaging, efficiency, and performance insights.

Qualifications


High-performance mindset and drive. Our culture is strongly based on results.
Experience in the travel industry (required), ideally luxury travel.
HubSpot Marketing Hub certified, or demonstrably proficient in all aspects of the platform. You must be a system expert.
3+ years of experience in email marketing with a proven track record of success, including:
Significant expansion of email subscriber lists
Continual growth of engagement rates
Campaigns that delivered high conversion rates and significant revenue growth
Detailed reports showing profitability across platforms and campaigns
Experience with email marketing automation tools and workflows.
Strong understanding of email marketing best practices, including segmentation, personalization, and A/B testing.
Excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities.
Impeccable written and verbal communication skills in English.
A creative mindset that produces high-performing, data-driven marketing.

Bonus Points


Experience in luxury travel or high-touch, high-ticket sales environments.
Strong background in inbound marketing methodology.
Experience integrating HubSpot with CRM data for end-to-end revenue attribution.
Working knowledge of HTML/CSS for custom email templates.
Familiarity with business intelligence tools such as Tableau or Power BI.

You’re a data-driven email marketing pro who thrives in a fast-paced, results-oriented environment.

You don’t just send emails, you understand the story behind the numbers and use it to make every campaign smarter than the last.

You’re equally comfortable building a complex HubSpot workflow, writing a subject line that earns the open, and presenting performance results to stakeholders.

You’re creative, analytical, and accountable, and you take ownership of your revenue targets as if they were your own.

Why You’ll Love This Role

As Email Marketing Specialist, you’ll have direct ownership of a channel that drives millions in revenue for UJV. You’ll work closely with the Marketing team, designers, content creators, and Sales to shape how we engage travelers across their entire journey.

If you’re excited about combining creativity, data, and HubSpot mastery to deliver measurable results, this is an opportunity to make a lasting impact.

Amazon Music is seeking a Partner Growth Manager to execute partnership growth strategies. This role will own the end-to-end partnership marketing lifecycle — from planning through execution — working closely with internal teams and external partners to drive new audience growth, customer acquisition, engagement, and retention for Amazon Music.

For someone to be successful in this role, they need to embody the following:

Their work is tactical, and they are learning to be strategic.

Cross-Functional Influencer: They influence across external partners, internal teams, and geographies to deliver outcomes. They build consensus across diverse functions (Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Business Development) and present recommendations to leadership.

Relationship Builder: They excel at fostering and maintaining strong relationships across all levels — from partner contacts to internal stakeholders — demonstrating strong communication skills and the ability to earn trust and influence.

Data-Driven Decision Maker: They have a natural curiosity for analytics and metrics, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights. They dive deep into performance data to identify trends and optimize campaign performance across the customer lifecycle.

Results Oriented & Operationally Excellent: They take ownership and drive initiatives from concept to completion, mitigating immediate risks and making trade-offs between time, quality, and resources. They identify and optimize process improvements for the team to drive outputs and sustained growth impact.

Key job responsibilities


 Execute partner marketing and growth strategies for Amazon Music partners, delivering against customer acquisition, engagement, and retention goals
 Own and execute go-to-market plans for partner launches for growth marketing efforts, including planning, execution, analysis/reporting, and optimization
 Continually optimize partnerships from launch through ongoing sustaining efforts to maximize offer discoverability, frequency in communications, share of voice, and identifying new opportunities within existing partnerships
 Implement and launch partner campaigns with the goal of delivering creative excellence that represents the Amazon Music brand and drives awareness through partners

At least 2 years of practical experience in digital marketing.

description:
Job Description

About us

With over 200 brands sold in nearly 180 countries, Diageo is home to some of the world’s most iconic drinks. From Johnnie Walker and Guinness to Tanqueray, Smirnoff and Don Julio, we craft brands chosen for life’s moments — from everyday connections to landmark celebrations.

Bring your talent, curiosity and ambition, and strive for your personal best alongside people who challenge, support and learn from each other. Together, as one outstanding team, we keep learning, improving and raising the bar for our brands, our business and each other.

Join us and play your part in making life’s moments mean a little more.

Purpose of the Role

Regional content studios are part of MOM's regional hubs, helping markets deliver the right content faster through greater reuse, better coordination and consistent ways of working. They focus primarily on adapting global content for local markets, while supporting local brand content where needed, using the tools, capabilities and processes defined by the central team. Diageo teams lead the studio, while agency partners deliver creative adaptation and production.

The Regional Content Operations Lead manages content demand and delivery for assigned categories across markets. This role is the day-to-day link between market and brand teams and the agency delivery team, reviewing briefs, challenging low-value requests, maximising reuse, choosing the right delivery route and ensuring assets are delivered on time and ready for approval, storage and reuse.

Key Accountabilities


Manage content demand and delivery for assigned categories, with a primary focus on adapting GBT assets for market use.
Review and clarify briefs from markets and brand teams, challenging unclear, duplicated or low-value asks and improving briefing quality over time.
Check for reuse before production and decide the most efficient route: reuse, GBT asset adaptation, Pencil/AI production, agency production or new-to-world only where truly needed.
Translate market needs into clear agency briefs, including assets, formats, mandatories, timelines, approval needs, delivery route and creative direction.
Guide the agency on workflows, templates, production approach and adaptation requirements, reviewing outputs where needed to ensure they are fit for purpose.
Track status, risks and missing inputs through the Planning & Briefing Platform, escalating issues and ensuring final assets are ready for approval, storage, tagging and reuse.


Key Competencies


 Brand Proposition
 Brand Activation


Qualifications And Experience Required


CONTENT DELIVERY EXPERIENCE: 6+ years of experience in content delivery, creative operations, marketing operations, agency account management, brand management, production or regional marketing.
CREATIVE JUDGMENT: Strong in-house or creative agency background, with the ability to understand briefs, judge outputs, provide clear feedback and bridge brand teams and agency partners.
BRIEFING & ADAPTATION EXPERTISE: Strong understanding of content briefing, reuse, adaptation, production workflows, approval requirements and market delivery needs.
AI & TOOL KNOWLEDGE: Good working knowledge of AI-enabled production, Pencil or similar tools, DAM/Libraries and content planning platforms.
PROJECT MANAGEMENT: Able to manage multiple briefs, deadlines, stakeholders and agency workflows at the same time.
PUSHBACK & EXECUTION: Detail-oriented and confident challenging weak briefs or unnecessary new creation, with focus on speed, reuse, cost efficiency, quality and market service.


Diversity Statement

Our purpose is crafting iconic drinks chosen for life’s moments. And it’s our people, with their different experiences, perspectives and talents, who make that possible.

skills: Fuel Our Omnichannel Journeys: Work with our Campaign Strategist to turn customer journey blueprints into creative and clear video assets for key lifecycle moments (onboarding and adoption).

Cross-Functional Alignment: Serve as the visual bridge between CS and Marketing, ensuring video and motion content aligns with current product positioning and brand guidelines while staying utility-focused for customer success.

Outcome-Based Video Design: Ensure every video or motion asset is designed to drive a specific, measurable user action or product milestone—not just sit in a video library. Every action should be tied to a clear impact or outcome.

Own Short-Form Video & Motion Production: Script, record, edit, and animate concise, high-retention video content tailored for digital CS channels. This includes micro-learning reels, feature spotlights, UI walkthroughs, and small animated GIFs.
Trend & Data Monitoring: Track engagement metrics (completion rates, drop-offs, feature activation post-view) alongside customer and media trends to continuously refine our video formats.

Build Our Video Production Engine: Establish internal visual asset libraries, motion graphics templates, and streamlined editing workflows so our CS team can scale visual content fast. You will execute simple, effective animations inspired by best-in-class examples from companies like Adobe, Wistia, Figma, Slack, Pendo, Bitly, and Asana.

AI-Powered Workflow Efficiency: Leverage generative AI and automation tools (e.g., AI script generation, synthetic voice/audio enhancement, rapid editing, and generative asset design) to accelerate production cycles, iterate rapidly on video variants, and elevate content quality.
Experience: 3+ years creating short-form video content, micro-learning clips, or motion graphics for tech or B2B SaaS platforms.
Portfolio: A proven portfolio demonstrating your video creation and motion graphics capabilities is mandatory.
Education: A bachelor's degree in a relevant field is required.
Location & Travel: The role is remote across Latin America. You must possess an active US visa to enable travel to the United States approximately once every 6 months for team meetings.
Language Proficiency: Full English proficiency is an absolute must, as this role involves presenting directly to US-based product managers.
Core Technical Stack: Proficiency with industry-standard editing software, strictly including Adobe Premiere Pro and After Effects, is mandatory.

Short-Form Storytelling: Demonstrated ability to script, record, edit, and animate high-retention, utility-focused video assets under 90 seconds (UI walkthroughs, feature spotlights, micro-learning reels).
Domain Knowledge: Prior experience creating content or training materials for Public Safety, emergency response, or government tech sectors is highly desired.
Marketing Alignment: Background or prior experience in customer marketing, lifecycle marketing, or customer success serves as a strong plus.
Supplementary Tools: Familiarity with screen recording and hosting tools like Wistia (preferred) or Camtasia.
Graphic Design Capabilities: Hands-on experience with design tools outside of video editing software (e.g., Figma, Canva, or Adobe Illustrator/InDesign) to create custom supporting visual assets.
AI Tool Familiarity: Hands-on experience using generative AI tools to accelerate video production workflows.

Process & System Building: Proven track record of building internal video production engines from scratch, including creating visual asset libraries, motion graphics templates, and scalable editing workflows.

Data & Analytics Literacy: Experience tracking and interpreting video engagement metrics (e.g., completion rates, post-view feature activation) to measure ROI and continuously refine content strategy.

Cross-Functional Enablement Experience: Prior experience collaborating directly with Customer Success, Campaign Strategists, or Enablement leads to map video assets into automated customer journeys and in-app triggers.

About North Star Network

North Star Network (NSN) is a global sports and betting media group that builds and operates leading digital brands connecting sports fans and bettors across 30+ countries.

Our mission is to turn passion for sports and gaming into trusted information, data-driven insights, and responsible entertainment.

We’re a multicultural, fully remote company uniting over 50 in-house and 200+ external experts from more than 20 nationalities across Europe, Africa, and the Americas.

About The Role

We are looking for a Content Writer dedicated to the Mexican market.

As a Content Writer, you will be responsible for producing high-quality, accurate, and SEO-driven content tailored to the Mexican audience. Your work will play a key role in attracting, engaging, and converting users across our iGaming and sports platforms.

Reporting to a Content Manager or Senior Content Manager, you will collaborate closely with Editors, SEO specialists, and other Writers to ensure our content meets the highest editorial standards while supporting traffic growth and monetization goals.

This role is ideal for writers who combine strong editorial skills, in-depth knowledge of the Mexican market, and a performance-driven mindset in fast-paced digital environments

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation

Write original, high-quality articles following provided briefs, tone, and structure.

Adapt writing style to match different markets, audiences, and brands.

Ensure factual accuracy and clarity while maintaining an engaging and professional tone.

Produce a consistent volume of content within deadlines, meeting quality and SEO expectations.

Conduct research on relevant topics, trends, and operators to ensure up-to-date and reliable information.

Provide first-person experience and in-depth expertise.

SEO Integration

Apply SEO best practices in writing: use of keywords, internal linking, meta tags, and structured formatting.

Follow content briefs and editorial guidelines to optimize for visibility and conversion.

Collaborate with SEO specialists and Content Managers to adjust existing content when needed.

Track article performance when requested and use feedback to improve writing and targeting.

Review articles on a regular basis to flag outdated information and to implement updates requested from Content Managers.

Collaboration & Feedback

Work closely with Editors and Content Managers to refine drafts and integrate feedback.

Cooperate with other writers to maintain consistent quality and tone across projects.

Participate in content reviews and workshops to improve writing quality and efficiency.

Communicate proactively about challenges, progress, and content ideas.

Compliance & Quality

Ensure all content complies with brand, editorial, and regulatory guidelines, particularly in iGaming and sports-related topics.

Maintain accuracy and neutrality when writing about operators, games, or predictions.

Perform self-proofreading before submission and ensure minimal editing needs.

Keep updated with market regulations, trends, and audience expectations.

What We’re Looking For

Native or near-native Spanish speaker with strong cultural and market knowledge of Mexico

(a must) .

Proven experience as a Content Writer, well versed in sports betting and iGaming

(mandatory) .

Strong writing skills in Mexican Spanish, with the ability to produce clear, persuasive and engaging content.

Solid experience writing SEO-driven content.

Practical knowledge of CMS platforms (e.g. WordPress).

Comfortable working in a remote, multicultural environment.

What We Offer

Work on high-traffic international brands reaching millions of sports fans worldwide.

100% remote work possible.

Join a diverse, international team passionate about sports, content, and digital innovation.

Opportunities to grow within a fast-expanding global media company.

A culture of autonomy, trust, and collaboration.

Competitive Compensation Depending On Experience And Seniority.

Born at Stanford and built by doctors for doctors, our platform introduces AI Healthcare Employees that work invisibly inside clinical workflows: transcribing consultations in real time, generating structured medical records, offering evidence-based decision support, and integrating seamlessly with any current health system, all without disrupting the physician's flow.

Already adopted by thousands of doctors and leading hospitals across the region, Telepatia has demonstrated measurable impact: reducing cognitive load, improving patient experience, and increasing adherence to clinical protocols.

Our vision is bold: to turn scarcity into abundance by empowering healthcare professionals with scalable, trustworthy intelligence, and to pursue nothing less than the first Nobel Prize in Medicine for Latin America since 1984 with an AI Doctor.

About The Role

Doctors do not adopt software because a contract was signed. They adopt it because someone was next to them during their first consultations, answered their questions, fixed the small things and showed them the note was better than what they would have typed. That someone is you.

You will spend most of your time in the field, inside hospitals and clinics, making sure doctors learn, trust and love the product. You are the bridge between medical teams, our product and the engineering squads.

Core skills: (i) Empathy and communication with doctors (ii) Adaptability and organization in unstructured environments (iii) Persistence in driving adoption (iv) Energy and ownership.

One requirement: Be patient-centered (and cool). Languages: Spanish (native), English (basic technical comprehension).

What you will do Guide doctors during their first consultations with Telepatia's scribe, on site, specialty by specialty.

Provide hands‑on support (technical and emotional) to make the transition to AI‑assisted documentation smooth.

Monitor adoption metrics: consultations per doctor, drop‑off rate, time to first success; act on them daily.

Collect feedback and communicate insights to product, engineering and the Medicine team.

Assist with patient consent (consentimiento informado) and make sure compliance is in place at every site.

Coordinate with Forward Deployed Engineers for setup and technical troubleshooting.

Train new users on best practices to maximize note accuracy and speed; identify champions who help usage grow organically. What we look for

More than experience, we look for attitude and drive. Recent graduate or early career: nursing, biomedical engineering, health administration, clinical research coordination or hospital operations.

Strong communication skills and empathy with medical professionals; comfortable with busy, skeptical doctors.

Proven ability to work independently in fast‑paced, unstructured environments.

Comfort spending most of your time inside hospitals, interacting with different specialists.

Passion for healthcare, technology and improving doctors' lives.

Grit, ownership and emotional intelligence. Nice to have Hospital operations, digital health or change management experience.

Junior medical representative or clinical research coordinator background.

Experience activating users for a software, fintech or medical‑device company. What we offer Variable: based on doctor activation performance.

Training with the Onboarding team in Colombia, where more than 25 institutions have been activated.

Direct mentorship from the AI Deployment Strategist and the Country Manager.

Career progression into Lead Onboarding Specialist, Customer Success or the Medicine team as Mexico scales.

Every doctor you activate touches thousands of patients. How we work We're always on.

We own what we do and don't wait for anyone.

We move fast and with focus.

We play to win. What this means for you Ask questions. There are no silos; we grow by learning together. Own your work. Don't wait until tomorrow; don't hand over unfinished work. Speak up. Every voice matters, no matter the title. Focus on impact. Prioritize what moves the needle.

Leave things better than you found them. Motivation and alignment: 30 minutes with the People team. Scenario simulation: 45 minutes: doctor onboarding role‑play, with the AI Deployment Strategist. Culture and values: 30 minutes with a founder, Mau or Cata.

description:
About Glia

Glia is the #1 Banking AI platform, empowering community and regional financial institutions to create efficiencies, accelerate loan growth, drive deposits, and deliver experiences that win against megabanks and fintechs.

Glia's Banking AI Operating System is a central intelligence layer on top of existing tech stacks, activating an AI workforce of specialized agents that draw from banking data, interaction history, and integrated systems of record. These banking-trained agents automate workflows across voice and digital–from front office to back office–resulting in decreased operational costs and the Universal Banker model.

Trusted by 700+ banks and credit unions for its ironclad security and reliability, Glia delivers the industry’s first contractual no-hallucination guarantee. It’s why Glia customers quickly and confidently put Banking AI to work with measurable results from day one. More information about Glia can be found at glia.com.

The Role

As a Senior Associate Launch Manager, you’ll become a leading expert in all Glia products and be the face of Glia to our Clients as they onboard. Each Client has unique needs and you will need to act as a trusted advisor, providing technical and operational guidance to help them effectively leverage our products, drive maximum business impact, and accelerate time-to-value.

The ideal candidate…


Is known for their attention to detail as well as their ability to see the big picture
Has supported or led multiple onboarding projects simultaneously
Understands they are accountable for the success of a project and ensures their team gets the work done on time
Is excited to create new processes that drive efficiencies
Understands the importance of communication and the value of tight relationships, cross-functionally as well as within their direct team
Is a natural leader who uses influence to drive success


Glia has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture—we look for people who are curious, inventive, and work to be a little better every single day.

If this sounds like a good fit for you, why not say hello?

What You’ll Do


Implementation Portfolio Management: Oversee and support a portfolio of client implementation projects across their complete lifecycle, from the initial Sales hand-off through to a successful launch.
Cross-Functional Management: Serve as the consultant, application configuration expert, and project manager while keeping both internal and external teams engaged and aligned.
Value Delivery: Translate the deployment of Glia’s tools and technology into measurable ROI for the customer, communicating this value clearly and consistently to executive stakeholders.

Enablement: Confidently train client administrators on platform configuration and support operators through simulated training exercises.

description:
About Watershed

Watershed is the enterprise sustainability platform. Companies like Airbnb, Carlyle Group, FedEx, Visa, and Dr. Martens use Watershed to manage climate and ESG data, produce audit-ready metrics for voluntary and regulatory reporting including CSRD, and drive real decarbonization. We are looking for team members who love product-building, want to work hard at a mission-oriented startup, and will collaborate with us in shaping the culture of a growing team.

We have offices in San Francisco, New York, Denver, London, Paris, Berlin, Sydney, Mexico City, and remote team members across the US and Europe. We hope that you'll be interested in joining us!

The role

We are looking for a customer-focused and analytically-minded individual to be a member of our Mexico City office on the Sustainability data advisory team. This is an opportunity to join a core team at a growth-stage start-up that works with the world's top companies to accelerate their sustainability programs. You'll work directly with customers as a trusted advisor, leading measurement sessions and delivering advisory services that unlock the full value of our platform — enabling our customers to gain clear, reliable insights into their sustainability impact and achieve their sustainability goals.

You will:


Advise sustainability teams at many of the world’s top companies. You’ll work directly with customers on how to measure actionable carbon and non-carbon footprints to reach sustainability goals and enable real reductions, ranging from scoping new measurements to in-depth methodology comparisons between footprints. 
Deliver services that accelerate customer success, helping customers set up their measurements to meet sustainability goals, serving as a trusted partner in emissions verifications, and providing specialized advisory to optimize their data and methodologies. You'll ensure customers unlock maximum value from Watershed's platform faster and more effectively than they could on their own. 
Collaborate with science, engineering, and product teams to pioneer innovative measurement solutions and expand Watershed's sustainability intelligence layer. 


You might be a fit if you:


Have 4-6 years of experience in a consulting, solutions-engineering, or other customer-facing role. You are excited to work directly with customers to help them set the foundation for world-class sustainability programs. 
Have experience in sustainability-related fields, greenhouse gas accounting and/or ESG reporting. 
Are an excellent verbal and written communicator. You can communicate complex topics to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Learn quickly and operate well in ambiguity. You are organized, systematic, and efficient. You thrive in a high-volume environment. 
Think clearly about complex problems, and are comfortable using and speaking to data. You are meticulous and detail-obsessed. 
Are passionate about solving climate change and excited to contribute to doing so at a fast-paced startup. 
Have strong English language proficiency


This position is required to be in person in our Mexico City office 4 days per week.

Must be willing to work from an office 4 days per week (except for remote roles)

Watershed has hub offices in San Francisco, New York, London, and Mexico City and satellite offices in Denver, Sydney, Paris, and Berlin. Where we have offices, employees are expected to be in office for 4 days per week. Certain jobs are open to being remote and will be specifically noted on the jobs page and in the job description if so.

What’s the interview process like?

It starts the same for every candidate: getting to know the team members through 1 to 2 conversations about Watershed, your experience, and your interests. Next steps can vary by role, but usual next steps are a skill or experience interview (e.g. a coding interview for an engineer, a portfolio review for a designer, deeper experience call for other roles) which leads to a virtual or in person interview panel. We prioritize transparency and lack of surprise throughout the process.

What if I need accommodations for my interview?

At Watershed, we are dedicated to ensuring an inclusive recruitment process. We provide reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities, long-term conditions, mental health needs, religious observances, neurodivergence, or pregnancy-related support requirements. If you need assistance during your process, please contact your recruiter.

Materiales promocionales: sesión informativa, proceso creativo y de desarrollo (diseño y enfoque médico), envío de VMAP (médico y reglamentario), proceso de distribución, reaprobaciones internas y externas y cambios de marca.

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34 M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution. About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies. You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and Rev Ops SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query Click House daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single Rev Ops contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in Rev Ops, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2 B Saa S, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2 B Saa S revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

Click House or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

Hub Spot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

Acerca de PayJoy




 




PayJoy, una Corporación de Beneficio Público, es una empresa de crédito con una misión clara: ayudar a clientes desatendidos en mercados emergentes a alcanzar la estabilidad y el éxito financiero. Nuestra tecnología patentada de crédito garantizado ofrece una vía de acceso para que nuevos clientes ingresen al sistema crediticio. A través del financiamiento en punto de venta y y las ofertas de tarjetas de PayJoy, los clientes obtienen acceso a una vida moderna y de calidad. El crédito de PayJoy también les permite aprovechar oportunidades como microempresarios y actuar como una forma de seguro. Al aprovechar tecnologías avanzadas como el aprendizaje automático, la ciencia de datos y la inteligencia artificial para la prevención del fraude, hemos prestado servicio a más de 18 millones de clientes hasta 2025, logrando una sólida rentabilidad que impulsa un crecimiento sostenible.




 




 




Acerca del rol




You'll own the technology behind how PayJoy reaches customers in collections, and turn it from something we maintain into something that drives results. That stack includes Customer.io, our data pipelines, external data (EDC) integrations and a growing set of AI vendors.




Your work will be visible and measurable. Better segmentation, smarter automation and clear vendor testing will lift recovery in every market while cutting manual work and cost per contact. This is a hands-on role for someone who likes building, testing and seeing their changes move real numbers.




Key Responsibilities







Run Customer.io for collections. Build and monitor workflows, messaging sequences and treatment triggers. Fix configuration issues, data mismatches and workflow failures so campaigns keep performing in every market


Automate what's still manual. Design treatment triggers, escalation logic and contact-sequencing rules. Spot manual processes that can be automated, and document every setup so the team can rely on it


Keep the data flowing. Build and maintain SQL/Python pipelines that feed customer and account data into Customer.io. Watch data quality and fix failures before they hit campaigns, working with our Data Analyst and Engineering


Connect external data. Set up and maintain EDC and third-party data integrations so new sources are validated and ready to use. Keep integration workflows and data dictionaries up to date


Test and scale AI tools. Pilot new collections tools such as conversational AI and smart contact prioritization. Measure each vendor against a control group on recovery, cost and ROI, then double down on what works


























Qualifications

Modern Marketing professional with understanding of latest developments in the marketing and media world.
Proven experience using data and analytics in deriving customer value.
Degree level qualification in marketing and/or business studies preferred.
Desirable business experience within a Financial Service based institution, or an innovative customer/service-based institution.
Experience in brand building strategies
Proven ability to work on multi-function projects demonstrating excellent relationship building skills.

High level of English language skills required.
Hands-on experience in creating content across different channels
description:
Role purpose

This role is part of the Brand Marketing team, which develops and executes customer-focused Digital and Social Media strategies and activities to deliver the objectives and ambitions of the Global Marketing strategy and plan, in turn driving revenue targets. It has a crucial role in ensuring Social Media as a brand building channel and also ensuring alignment with the Digital Media team in terms of performance.

Supporting the execution of market leading initiatives aligned to the Global Digital Marketing strategy

In-flight tracking of performance and measurement of key metrics, summarizing learnings for feeding into future initiatives
Driving innovation in the Social media channels, building on existing services and developing new Digital assets which align with the business and Marketing strategy

Support content production to communicate content regarding experiences, connecting with all the brand efforts (partnerships etc….)- Events coverage.
Role holders will be in charge of Influencers strategy, ensuring development according to Social Media and brand guidelines.
Social media crisis management: ensure continuous monitoring to prevent any reputational crisis. Ensure alignment and fluent communication with key stakeholders to manage or implement any action plan when any crisis happens.


Requirements


At least 5-7 years experience on social media management; from end to end ( from setting social media strategy to deliver communication strategy)

High level of English language skills required.

title: Campaign Manager
skills: Core Mission: Act as the primary execution anchor and strategic client contact to manage post-sale campaign lifecycles and maximize campaign delivery across Mexico.
Team Alignment: Work closely with Sales, Associate Campaign Managers, and Ad Operations to translate client briefs into high-performing media activations.
Scope of Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for campaign setup, tracking, pacing, optimization, post-campaign analysis, and incremental revenue growth.
Portfolio Ownership: Own and grow a dedicated portfolio of agency and holding group accounts, acting as the day-to-day reference for Sales, clients and internal teams on every campaign within it.

Impact Metric: Success in this role means achieving full campaign delivery within SLAs, maintaining high client satisfaction, and driving upsell opportunities through actionable insights and performance data.
Provide RFP strategy to ensure storytelling is consistent across all departments, including creating client presentations, media plans, and inventory forecasts.
Introduce new products strategically in line with commercial and operational guidelines.
Partner with Sales on pre-sale client communications and technical requirements.
Lead kick-off calls for upcoming campaign launches with agency and client stakeholders across all activation types (Managed Service, Self Service, and Programmatic Deal IDs).
Onboard clients to our self-service buying platform, guiding them through feature adoption and campaign setup.
Serve as the lead point of contact for all client communications following the sale, maintaining clear and concise alignment prior to activation.
Oversee post-sale operations, including campaign setup, pacing, delivery, site list requests, and post-campaign analysis.
Optimize proactively by monitoring pacing, delivery, viewability and performance KPIs, anticipating risks and recommending changes (site lists, formats, targeting) before they become client issues.

Manage ad serving and verification setups, including third-party tags, VAST, and brand safety and viewability measurement, and troubleshoot discrepancies across ad servers, DSPs and verification vendors.
Set up and monitor programmatic deals (PMPs, PG, Deal IDs) across the DSPs our clients buy through, coordinating with agencies and Ad Operations.
Delegate and partner effectively with Associate Campaign Managers and Ad Operations teams for tagging, site tracking, reporting, screenshots, and availability pulls.
Analyze campaign performance data to highlight key trends and surface actionable insights for clients.

Deliver Final Reports, QBR/YBR inputs and ad-hoc analyses on agreed deadlines, keeping every request logged in our team tracker (Monday) with clear owners and dates, and renegotiating timelines transparently when needed.
Lead client workshops and deep dives on topics such as viewability, brand safety and campaign performance, translating technical data into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Support commercial analyses (CPM, site-level costs and margin) on key accounts, helping Sales and leadership balance client goals with profitability.
Document client-specific exceptions, processes and learnings in shared team tools so any account can be covered seamlessly.
Plan and execute quarterly incremental revenue prospecting plans in close collaboration with the Sales team.
Contribute to internal team development through consistent knowledge sharing and operational best practice exercises.
Core Experience: 2 to 3+ years of relevant experience within a digital media agency, publisher, SSP, DSP, or AdTech company.
Programmatic Ecosystem: Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem (SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, deal types and how the pieces connect) and of tactical systems such as Salesforce.
DSPs: Working knowledge of multiple DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk) and of how campaigns and deals are set up, paced and optimized in each.
Ad Servers: Understanding of how third-party ad servers work: tagging, trafficking, VAST, tracking and discrepancy troubleshooting.
Brand Safety & Verification: Familiarity with the verification environment (e.g., IAS, DV, MOAT) and how brand safety, viewability and fraud measurement affect delivery and reporting.

Organization & Time Management: Highly organized, with a proven track record of managing competing priorities and balancing big-picture plans with daily execution detail across multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment.
Proactivity & Ownership: A self-starter who anticipates issues, flags risks early and brings solutions instead of waiting to be asked.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with comfort engaging strategic client stakeholders.
Language & Location: Professional fluency in English and Spanish; right to work in Mexico.
Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on experience with programmatic deal setups (PMPs, PG deals) and self-service ad platforms.
Prior experience identifying incremental revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
Experience with work management tools (e.g., Monday) and with building client-ready reports and presentations.
Meaningful scope & real ownership — work with trusted autonomy and direct impact on client outcomes in Mexico.
Global exposure and genuinely complex challenges at real scale — reaching over 2.2 billion users monthly across 18 billion ad opportunities daily.
Smart, ambitious peers across 30+ markets in a collaborative, cross-border setup.
A genuinely human culture — high care alongside high accountability.
Real investment in your growth — structured mentorship, coaching, courses, workshops, and development programs.

A New Era of Media: We’ve merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web.

AI-Powered Innovation: We actively embrace AI and next-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising.

Growth & High Performance: Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive.

Belonging & Impact: We foster a welcoming, diverse environment where approachable, resourceful, and passionate people excel. Through our employee-led Employee Resource Groups (ERGs), you can actively drive change in areas like sustainability, women’s empowerment, charitable initiatives, and DE&I.
description:
About Teads

Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform building the future of digital advertising where quality content, trusted publishers, ambitious brands, and human creativity can thrive. Operating at true scale - processing 18 billion ad opportunities every single day - we connect global brands with a monthly reach of over 2.2 billion unique users.

At Teads, we believe your impact travels further. We are a borderless team of 1,700+ innovators across 30+ countries who favor outcome over tenure, value trusted autonomy, and use predictive AI to amplify human ingenuity rather than replace it. We move at pace, tackle genuinely complex problems, and foster a high-accountability culture that stays genuinely human. If you are looking for room to build and meaningful scope, you belong here. Learn more at www.teads.com.

About The Opportunity

At Teads, we are looking for a dynamic and client-focused Campaign Manager to join our Mexico team. This role sits within our Client Services organization and acts as a critical commercial and operational anchor supporting our Sales team. Following our continued expansion across Latin America, you will own post-sale campaign execution, foster strong client relationships, and drive campaign success across our platform.

In this role, you will collaborate daily with Sales, Associate Campaign Managers, and Ad Operations to deliver high-impact digital media solutions for top brands and agencies across Mexico.


Core Mission: Act as the primary execution anchor and strategic client contact to manage post-sale campaign lifecycles and maximize campaign delivery across Mexico.
Team Alignment: Work closely with Sales, Associate Campaign Managers, and Ad Operations to translate client briefs into high-performing media activations.
Scope of Ownership: Take end-to-end accountability for campaign setup, tracking, pacing, optimization, post-campaign analysis, and incremental revenue growth.
Portfolio Ownership: Own and grow a dedicated portfolio of agency and holding group accounts, acting as the day-to-day reference for Sales, clients and internal teams on every campaign within it.
Impact Metric: Success in this role means achieving full campaign delivery within SLAs, maintaining high client satisfaction, and driving upsell opportunities through actionable insights and performance data.


What will you do?

Pre-Sale Strategy & Client Readiness


Provide RFP strategy to ensure storytelling is consistent across all departments, including creating client presentations, media plans, and inventory forecasts.
Introduce new products strategically in line with commercial and operational guidelines.
Partner with Sales on pre-sale client communications and technical requirements.


Execution & Campaign Ownership


Lead kick-off calls for upcoming campaign launches with agency and client stakeholders across all activation types (Managed Service, Self Service, and Programmatic Deal IDs).
Onboard clients to our self-service buying platform, guiding them through feature adoption and campaign setup.
Serve as the lead point of contact for all client communications following the sale, maintaining clear and concise alignment prior to activation.
Oversee post-sale operations, including campaign setup, pacing, delivery, site list requests, and post-campaign analysis.
Optimize proactively by monitoring pacing, delivery, viewability and performance KPIs, anticipating risks and recommending changes (site lists, formats, targeting) before they become client issues.
Manage ad serving and verification setups, including third-party tags, VAST, and brand safety and viewability measurement, and troubleshoot discrepancies across ad servers, DSPs and verification vendors.
Set up and monitor programmatic deals (PMPs, PG, Deal IDs) across the DSPs our clients buy through, coordinating with agencies and Ad Operations.


Cross-Functional Collaboration & Performance


Delegate and partner effectively with Associate Campaign Managers and Ad Operations teams for tagging, site tracking, reporting, screenshots, and availability pulls.
Analyze campaign performance data to highlight key trends and surface actionable insights for clients.
Deliver Final Reports, QBR/YBR inputs and ad-hoc analyses on agreed deadlines, keeping every request logged in our team tracker (Monday) with clear owners and dates, and renegotiating timelines transparently when needed.
Lead client workshops and deep dives on topics such as viewability, brand safety and campaign performance, translating technical data into clear messages for non-technical audiences.
Support commercial analyses (CPM, site-level costs and margin) on key accounts, helping Sales and leadership balance client goals with profitability.
Document client-specific exceptions, processes and learnings in shared team tools so any account can be covered seamlessly.
Plan and execute quarterly incremental revenue prospecting plans in close collaboration with the Sales team.
Contribute to internal team development through consistent knowledge sharing and operational best practice exercises.


What will you bring to the team?

Must-Haves (The Baseline Bar)


Core Experience: 2 to 3+ years of relevant experience within a digital media agency, publisher, SSP, DSP, or AdTech company.
Programmatic Ecosystem: Solid understanding of the programmatic ecosystem (SSPs, DSPs, ad exchanges, deal types and how the pieces connect) and of tactical systems such as Salesforce.
DSPs: Working knowledge of multiple DSPs (e.g., DV360, The Trade Desk) and of how campaigns and deals are set up, paced and optimized in each.
Ad Servers: Understanding of how third-party ad servers work: tagging, trafficking, VAST, tracking and discrepancy troubleshooting.
Brand Safety & Verification: Familiarity with the verification environment (e.g., IAS, DV, MOAT) and how brand safety, viewability and fraud measurement affect delivery and reporting.
Organization & Time Management: Highly organized, with a proven track record of managing competing priorities and balancing big-picture plans with daily execution detail across multiple campaigns in a fast-paced environment.
Proactivity & Ownership: A self-starter who anticipates issues, flags risks early and brings solutions instead of waiting to be asked.
Communication & Stakeholder Management: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with comfort engaging strategic client stakeholders.
Language & Location: Professional fluency in English and Spanish; right to work in Mexico.


Nice-to-Haves (The Performance Multiplier)


Degree in Marketing, Advertising, Business Administration, or equivalent practical experience.
Hands-on experience with programmatic deal setups (PMPs, PG deals) and self-service ad platforms.
Prior experience identifying incremental revenue opportunities within existing accounts.
Experience with work management tools (e.g., Monday) and with building client-ready reports and presentations.


What You’ll Get

At Teads, your scope is bigger than your title. Here is what you can count on in return:


Meaningful scope & real ownership — work with trusted autonomy and direct impact on client outcomes in Mexico.
Global exposure and genuinely complex challenges at real scale — reaching over 2.2 billion users monthly across 18 billion ad opportunities daily.
Smart, ambitious peers across 30+ markets in a collaborative, cross-border setup.
A genuinely human culture — high care alongside high accountability.
Real investment in your growth — structured mentorship, coaching, courses, workshops, and development programs.


At Teads, your impact travels further.

Please submit your CV in English.

Life at Teads

At Teads, we don’t just offer jobs. We blend creativity, technology, and cutting-edge data to shape the future of media.

As a Teadster, you’ll work alongside smart humans, collaborate with meaningful brands, and leverage advanced AI and automation to redefine how advertising works in a transparent, privacy-first world.

We are builders, innovators, and future-thinkers. If you are excited by the evolution of technology and ready to embrace the future of AI-driven media, you belong here.

Why Join Us?


A New Era of Media: We’ve merged two open internet category leaders, Outbrain and Teads to create a unified omnichannel platform. Together, we drive results from branding to performance across CTV, mobile, and web.
AI-Powered Innovation: We actively embrace AI and next-gen technology to solve complex industry challenges. We look for curious minds who aren't afraid to experiment, adapt, and lead the charge into the future of digital advertising.
Growth & High Performance: Our culture is dynamic, global, and built on excellence. We are committed to your success, offering the modern tools, mentorship, and development opportunities you need to thrive.

Equal Opportunity Employer

title: Media Executive Stellantis
description:
Descripción de la empresa

Publicis Groupe México es una destacada agencia de publicidad y comunicación integral que ofrece

soluciones creativas y estratégicas en marketing digital, medios y relaciones públicas. Parte del

conglomerado global Publicis Groupe, se especializa en innovar y conectar marcas con sus audiencias a

través de campañas efectivas y tecnología avanzada.

Descripción del puesto

Apoyar en la implementación, seguimiento, optimización y cierre de campañas de medios, asegurando el cumplimiento de los planes aprobados, el control administrativo de la inversión y la entrega puntual de reportes. La posición coordina actividades con equipos internos, clientes, plataformas y proveedores para mantener una operación ordenada y orientada a resultados.

Responsabilidades

No necesitas ser experto en medios. Si tienes potencial y las bases que buscamos, nuestro equipo te ayudará a desarrollar los conocimientos necesarios.

Enfoque de la vacante: Principalmente medios offline, más que online.

Implementar campañas de medios digitales y, cuando aplique, apoyar ejecuciones integradas con medios tradicionales.

Dar seguimiento a presupuestos, pacing, calendarios, materiales, especificaciones y entregables de campaña.

Cargar y actualizar órdenes de compra, planes, modificaciones y cierres en sistemas internos o ERP de medios.

Coordinar solicitudes con plataformas, publishers, proveedores, equipos de planeación, finanzas y servicio al cliente.

Type: Full-Time, Remote, EST business hours




About Venveo

Venveo is a fast-growing digital marketing agency helping home service brands grow and thrive online. From HVAC and roofing to landscaping and remodeling, we partner with companies that are experts at what they do — and we make sure they get seen, booked, and remembered.




The Role

We’re looking for a Local SEO Specialist with experience in home service-based industries to lead Local SEO across our client portfolio.




This is a hands-on leadership role: you will execute high-impact SEO work, leverage support resources where appropriate, and refine the standards, processes, and playbooks for Local SEO delivery. Over time, you will help build and grow the Local SEO department, setting the vision for how Venveo delivers local search results for our clients.




Your success in this role will be measured by:

Client Performance

Improvements in Map Grid rankings and local pack visibility
Growth in Google Business Profile visibility, actions, and leads
Increased website traffic from local and organic search
Increased website leads and conversions

Operational Leadership

Establishing clear, repeatable Local SEO processes and standards
Effectively executing high-impact SEO work while delegating recurring tasks
Maintaining quality and consistency across all client accounts
Contributing to the growth and maturity of the Local SEO function at Venveo




Responsibilities

Lead and conduct technical and content SEO audits to identify site issues and opportunities across client accounts.
Own keyword research and local search strategy to inform content and optimization plans.
Create content and optimization calendars aligned with keyword strategy and business goals.
Optimize existing and new content according to SEO best practices and AI-readiness standards.
Create or refine content using Surfer SEO or similar tools for priority pages and clients.

Oversee citation building and directory accuracy using BrightLocal or similar tools, leveraging support resources where appropriate.
Track SEO performance, keyword movement, and local search impact using ProRankTracker, GSC, and Looker Studio dashboards.
Implement and oversee on-site SEO improvements within CMS platforms (WordPress, Squarespace, Wix).
Stay ahead of SEO trends, including AI-driven search changes, AEO, and local SERP shifts, and evolve Venveo’s approach accordingly.
Optimize local and on-page content for AI and answer engines, ensuring visibility in voice, conversational, and location-based search results.
Deliver monthly reports with actionable insights focused on lead generation, conversions, and measurable business impact.
Collaborate closely with Executive Strategist, Producer, Project Coordinator, and support resources to ensure smooth workflows, clear communication, and strong client delivery.




Tools We Use

Must be proficient in:

Google Search Console
Google Analytics
Google My Business
WordPress, Squarespace, Wix
SEMrush, Ahrefs or Screaming Frog




Preferred experience with:

Surfer SEO
BrightLocal

Deep expertise in Local SEO and familiarity with AEO and GEO principles.
Proven ability to conduct technical SEO audits and implement on-site recommendations that drive measurable results.

We value sharp thinkers, a results-driven mindset, and people who take ownership from start to finish. LawRank is one of the most respected SEO and digital marketing firms serving the legal industry, working with high-revenue law firms across the country. Ongoing training
Real growth opportunities
Hybrid/Remote work

EverService is a global holdings company specializing in B2B professional services for companies of all sizes, helping them to grow and scale. Through its vertically integrated brands, EverService delivers performance-driven digital marketing solutions across the legal, home services, and professional services industries. description:
Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution.

The Company Is Founder Led, Profitable And Growing.

Marketers at Canonical are brand stewards and demand creators. They transform complex open-source technology into messages, stories, and strategies that shape the market understanding of our vision. Some focus on differentiated product and portfolio positioning; others specialize in account-based engagement, partner and alliance messaging, or product-led growth. Whatever their specialization, each marketer works as part of a cross-functional unit, contributing campaigns and insights that help the company learn and grow faster.

We have a bias for action, focus efforts on the most impactful activities, and take ownership of our results. We work across long buying cycles, balance storytelling with data, design experiments, track outcomes, and iterate rapidly to find what works.

Marketers at Canonical don’t just promote open source; they amplify it, ensuring our innovations reach the right people, at the right time, with clarity and purpose from developers to decision makers.

As an experienced marketer at Canonical, you’ll lead cross-disciplinary teams of product, partner, or sales professionals in your specific area, from establishing priorities and strategies with senior stakeholders to delivering on integrated campaigns. We are looking for both generalists who want to take ownership of a product portfolio or channel, and for specialists who can help the whole team excel in their domain of expertise.

Location: This is a globally remote role; you can be based in EMEA, APAC, or the Americas, depending on the team’s location.

The role entails

You will take ownership of one of our core marketing tracks and lead both strategy and execution. You’ll ensure campaigns land, launches succeed, and adoption grows, while contributing to the broader go-to-market engine.

You will:


Lead GTM strategy and campaign execution in your functional area
Align with product, sales, content, and partner teams to deliver integrated plans
Shape messaging, positioning, and assets that resonate with customers
Design and run experiments to test your hypothesis
Drive major launches, marketing initiatives, and growth programs
Run reviews and retrospectives to improve performance and impact
Mentor colleagues, strengthen the function, and set high standards for delivery



What we are looking for in you


Strong written and verbal communication in English
Exceptional academic track record from high school and university
Proven experience in B2B marketing, ideally in software, SaaS, or open source
Strong track record shaping go-to-market strategy, messaging, and campaigns that move the pipeline
Fast adaptation to change and new technology adoption in marketing
A leader, growing and elevating others across the organization 
A solid eye for ROI and effective budget management
Ability to influence and align stakeholders across the organization
Excellent communication and storytelling skills for technical solutions
Skilled at managing complex projects and leading cross-functional teams
Comfortable using data to evaluate campaigns and refine strategy
Proactive, outcome-driven, and confident, operating independently at a global scale



Nice-to-have skills


Background in sales-led or ecosystem growth
Familiarity with ABM (Account-Based Marketing) approaches
Experience leading go-to-market efforts across a large product portfolio
Experience managing budgets, agencies, or external vendors
Understanding of open source communities and business models
Experience mentoring or leading junior marketers



What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilization. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, please ask your Talent Partner.

🏠Fully remote working environment - we’ve been working remotely since 2004!

📚Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum

💰Annual compensation review

🏆Recognition rewards

🏝 Annual holiday leave

👶Parental Leave

🧑‍💼Employee Assistance Programme

🧳Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at ‘sprints’

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About The Team

Help define and amplify the Stripe story and connect our products with our users.

Our Product Marketing team’s mission is to generate insights that inform Stripe’s product strategy, lead go-to-market for our suite of products, and create and execute campaigns that drive product growth. Product Marketing is a highly cross-functional role at Stripe, partnering closely with Product and Engineering, Sales, Design, Developer Relations, and Communications. Unlike many other Product Marketing teams, our team works across the entire product lifecycle—from helping shape the product, to driving launch and commercialization, to growing product adoption after launch.

What you’ll do

As the regional product marketing lead for Latin America, you will champion the needs of users across the region and help define and develop a strong, trusted brand in the market. You will connect product, sales, and marketing to support Stripe’s growth while delivering successful user outcomes. Based in Mexico City, you will bring deep regional insight to Stripe’s product strategy and go-to-market execution across Latin America.

Responsibilities


Lead the delivery of regional product marketing priorities that drive growth for businesses across Latin America with a focus on Mexico, in close partnership with Product, go-to-market, and Marketing teams
Develop deep expertise in the needs of current and prospective users through user research, competitive landscape analysis, and product knowledge
Develop, deploy, and maintain market-specific value propositions, narratives, and messaging for marketing content, campaigns, and sales collateral
Drive high-quality product launches and adoption by partnering with Product, Sales, Engineering, Marketing, Design, Communications, Partnerships, and other cross-functional teams
Improve seller effectiveness across the region through product and solution training, market-specific content and tools, and field support
Monitor indicators of product adoption, usage, and satisfaction to identify barriers and opportunities across the regional growth funnel
Partner with country and regional marketing teams to develop content programs for priority events, integrated campaigns, and ongoing demand generation



Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum Requirements


8+ years of experience in B2B technology marketing or sales, including product marketing experience
Experience developing value propositions, messaging, go-to-market strategies, and sales materials for multiple markets or customer segments
Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and building alignment with senior stakeholders across Product, Sales, and Marketing
High professional fluency in Spanish and English, as this role will develop market-specific messaging and work with users and internal teams across Latin America
Ability to travel domestically and internationally for business



Preferred Qualifications


Experience marketing technology products or services across Latin America
Experience in payments, financial services, or financial technology
Experience working in a global technology company with distributed teams



In-office expectations

Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.

Pay and benefits

Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.

We look forward to hearing from you.

At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.

Apply now
