About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog.

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape What Comes Next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview:

At Coursera, our Data Science team is helping to build the future of education through data-driven decision making and data-powered products. We drive product and business strategy through measurement, experimentation, and causal inference to help Coursera deliver effective content discovery and personalized learning at scale. We believe the next generation of teaching and learning should be personalized, accessible, and efficient. With our scale, data, technology, and talent, Coursera and its Data Science team are positioned to make that vision a reality.

We are seeking a highly skilled and collaborative Senior Data Scientist to join our Data Science team. In this role, you will report directly to the Director of Data Science and play a pivotal role in shaping both our marketing and product strategies through data-driven insights and analytics. You will leverage your expertise in user behavior tracking, user segmentation, marketing performance measurement, instrumentation, A/B testing, and advanced analytics techniques to gain a deep understanding of user interactions and marketing effectiveness. Your insights will directly inform product development, enhance user experience, optimize campaign performance, and drive engagement across various segments.

Our ideal candidate possesses strong analytical skills, business acumen, and a deep understanding of marketing and product principles, along with the ability to translate analysis into actionable recommendations. You should have excellent written and verbal communication skills and excel in collaboration, working closely with cross-functional teams—including marketing managers, product managers, designers, and engineers—to ensure that data informs decision-making across both product and marketing.

Leverage statistical analysis and predictive modeling to inform product roadmap and strategic decisions.

Excellent business intuition and project management abilities.
Effective communication and presentation skills, with experience presenting to diverse teams and stakeholders, from individual contributors to executives.

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

title: Senior Revops Engineer
description:
About Improvado Improvado is an AI-powered marketing data platform built for mid-market and enterprise teams.

We help companies automate complex marketing data workflows, unify data at scale, and surface insights through BI and AI.

Brands like Genentech, T-Mobile, Activision, and H&R Block rely on us to simplify analytics and improve marketing performance.

We’re a fast-growing Series A startup backed by $34M in funding and driven by a team that moves fast, stays curious, and cares about high-quality execution.

About the role Improvado is a marketing data platform for enterprise brands and agencies.

You will own how our revenue runs and how it is measured.

That covers Salesforce and the GTM tools, the path from signed contract to paid invoice, the revenue data model, and the reports leadership decides from.

You work closely with the analytics team: you don’t have to build the data models yourself, but you must read them, spot what is wrong and say what to change.

You work through AI agents daily, doing the work of a bigger team.

What you will do Salesforce and GTM stack Own Salesforce configuration, release process and user access, plus the integrations around it (Gong, Clay, Lemlist, enrichment, e-signature, lead routing).

Keep CRM data clean with guardrails that block mistakes.

Manage licences and vendor renewals.

Maintain the Salesforce manual and RevOps SOPs, and train new hires.

Contract to cash Own ARR and bookings logic (new, upsell, downsell, churn, renewals) and keep agreement, opportunity, and invoice consistent.

Run the closed-deals and billing check with Finance.

Fix errors at the source and add a control so they don’t repeat.

Audit invoices, track and chase unpaid ones, and prepare quarterly commission and quota reports.

Revenue analytics and data model Own the quarterly sales analytics pack, the CRO report, the forecast and pipeline coverage (including CS renewal inputs).

Track funnel conversion, explain why deals move, stall or slip, and keep attribution correct with Marketing.

Query ClickHouse daily, trace any number to its source, and write specs for model changes.

Give each metric one documented definition and add data quality checks.

Build leadership dashboards, retire unused ones, and end every analysis with a recommendation, a number and an owner.

AI and automation Use coding agents (Claude Code, Codex) for queries, scripts and Salesforce automation, and always verify their output.

Automate manual work (invoice and payment checks, CRM hygiene, deal-risk alerts, call analysis) and measure hours saved and errors avoided.

Ownership Be the single RevOps contact for Sales, CS, Marketing, Finance and Product.

Turn each request into a task with an owner, date and success metric.

Requirements 4-6+ years in RevOps, Sales Ops or GTM systems in B2B SaaS, with hands‑on admin of a live Salesforce org.

Strong SQL and comfort in a modeled warehouse (layers, lineage, one definition per metric).

dbt is a plus.

Deep knowledge of the B2B SaaS revenue cycle: funnel, pipeline, forecast, ARR, churn, renewals.

Experience running the money side: contracts, invoicing, collections, kept in sync with the CRM.

Proof you build with AI agents: something you shipped that others use.

Fluent English and clear written updates without being asked.

Nice to have Salesforce Administrator or Advanced Administrator certification.

ClickHouse or another columnar warehouse, and any BI tool.

Gong, Clay, Lemlist, or workflow automation tools.

Billing, CPQ, or accounting systems.

HubSpot to Salesforce migration.

Attribution or CS health score data.

Martech or analytics company background.

What We Offer Remote-first environment Strong product/market fit: marketing data product for US-based enterprises 20 working days of PTO per year US holidays and additional days off Professional development reimbursement

description:
Our Purpose

Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.

Title And Summary

Managing Consultant, Advisors & Consulting Services, Marketing

ADVISORS & CONSULTING SERVICES

Services within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard’s rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.

The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Marketing consultants lead the strategy development and implementation of campaigns and engagements for clients. They use customer data to provide deep direct marketing expertise across channels, evaluating campaign results and adapting the approach to optimize marketing performance.

Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/consulting-specializations-at-mastercard

Envision this role as the pivot in a thrilling marketing services transformation. It's about fully embracing and fueling change while seamlessly balancing traditional marketing endeavors. This profile thrives in a dynamic environment, contributing ideas, and actively steering this transformational journey.

Roles And Responsibilities

Client Impact


 Deliver exceptional digital marketing initiatives guided by data analytics, ensuring measurable business impact
 Take charge of client projects, collaborating to conceptualize and execute impactful campaigns
 Lead the creation and end-to-end execution of Marketing Services projects focusing on financial performance and impact
 Implement data-driven digital marketing solutions, including campaigns, marketing automation, and lifecycle management initiatives
 Ensure operational project execution within agreed milestones and budget
 Manage creative development and media planning, meeting high-quality standards aligned with client needs
 Assess, recommend and improve the performance of client’s marketing activities by using data insights and data visualization tools



Team Collaboration & Culture


 Collaborate with internal and external marketing partners to support business growth



Qualifications


 Hands-on Experience: extended experience in integrated marketing, with a strong focus on digital marketing planning and data-driven implementation
 Client Management: Proven track record in managing client accounts and leading digital marketing solutions
 Project Execution: Ability to plan and execute marketing strategies and campaigns across key marketing channels to drive impactful outcomes
 Collaboration: Thrive in a matrix organization structure, manage internal and external stakeholders effectively
 Communication: Excellent communication and presentation skills, capable of influencing colleagues and clients on the value of digital marketing projects
 Innovation: Show the ability to ideate, manage, and roll out complex and competitive digital marketing initiatives
 Education: Relevant marketing degree or equivalent experience needed
 Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable)
 Eligibility to work in the country where you are applying, as well as apply for travel visas as required by travel needs



OUR PURPOSE

We work to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. We cultivate a culture of inclusion for all employees that respect their individual strengths, views, and experiences. We believe that our differences enable us to be a better team – one that makes better decisions, drives innovation, and delivers better business results.

Corporate Security Responsibility

 All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:


Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Community Lead - Kraken Pro
skills: Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.
Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.

Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.
Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.
Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.
Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.
Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.
You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.
3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.
You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.
You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.
You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.
You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.
You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.
description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. Offering spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken Pro is where serious traders work. Tight spreads, deep books, an API people actually build on. The people who use it are demanding, opinionated, and allergic to marketing.

We want someone who belongs in that room. Not a brand account with a person behind it, but a trader's trader who happens to be very good at building community.

Come here to build and grow this Community for us.

The opportunity


Live in the trenches. Discord, Telegram, X, TradingView, Reddit, the group chats you're already in at 3am. You're not "monitoring channels". You're a participant, with standing.
Be the fastest voice in the room. When a chain halts, a listing drops, or the market goes vertical, you're posting before the screenshots start circulating. Speed with accuracy, not vibes.
Build the inner circle. Stand up an ambassador and power-user program: the market makers, quant desks, and high-volume traders who'll tell you the truth about the product. Give them a reason to stay loud.
Run the room in public. AMAs, live trading sessions, feature launches, competitions, post-mortems when we get something wrong. Own the format, don't just attend it.
Close the loop with Product. You'll be the first to hear that the order entry flow is broken. Your job is to get it to the PM with receipts, then go back and tell the community what happened.
Write things people screenshot. Threads on microstructure, teardowns of new features, release notes that don't read like release notes.
Prove it worked. Sentiment, share of voice, community-sourced signups, retention of the accounts that matter. You bring the numbers to the table before anyone asks.


What You’ll Bring


You trade. Actual positions, actual scars. You can hold a conversation about funding rates, maker/taker economics, slippage, and latency without reaching for a glossary.
3+ years running community or social for a product with a technical, skeptical audience. Crypto, fintech, gaming, or dev tools all count.
You write fast and well. Short-form that lands, long-form that holds up under scrutiny from people smarter than the average follower.
You have thick skin and good instincts. Crypto community management means getting yelled at with an audience watching. You de-escalate without going corporate and you know when to push back.
You've built something from a standing start, not just maintained an existing account.
You operate without a brief. Markets don't wait for approval chains, and neither should you… because you know where the line is and you don't need a committee to find it.
You're comfortable with the ambiguity of a company that ships constantly and reorganizes around opportunity.

skills: Implementar y actualizar la estrategia regional de comunicación interna y externa, con énfasis en transformar las narrativas sobre la migración forzada y la movilidad impulsada por el clima, así como en movilizar un mayor apoyo público a estas causas.

Desarrollar y ejecutar planes de acción comunicacional creativos e innovadores dirigidos a públicos clave, incluyendo organizaciones locales o comunitarias, organizaciones socias, donantes, tomadores de decisiones, medios de comunicación y público en general.

Apoyar los esfuerzos de monitoreo y documentación en derechos humanos para generar evidencia que sustente las acciones estratégicas de comunicación e incidencia.
Actualizar periódicamente el calendario editorial y las herramientas relacionadas con el monitoreo y evaluación de actividades.
Elaborar informes periódicos sobre el impacto de las actividades.

Implementar acciones de fortalecimiento de capacidades del equipo en consonancia con la estrategia regional de comunicación de AFSC.

Actualizar el mapeo regional de medios, incluyendo personas influyentes, información de contacto, análisis de alcance e identificación de oportunidades para el posicionamiento narrativo.
Gestionar relaciones con medios de comunicación e identificar oportunidades para aumentar la visibilidad del trabajo de AFSC, organizaciones socias y aliados.
Mantener actualizado el mapeo de redes sociales de organizaciones socias y aliadas.

Administrar y actualizar las plataformas institucionales de redes sociales, garantizando coherencia en los mensajes, identidad de marca, valores institucionales y visibilidad del impacto programático.
Producir contenido escrito, visual y/o audiovisual que destaque el trabajo del programa y las voces de las personas y comunidades con las que trabajamos.

Mantener y ampliar relaciones con organizaciones socias y aliadas, medios de comunicación, periodistas, personas influyentes y otros actores de la sociedad civil que contribuyan al posicionamiento de AFSC y al cambio de narrativas.
Coordinar entrevistas con actores locales y regionales según se requiera y producir información clave basada en las prioridades y la estrategia aprobada.

Elaborar informes narrativos sobre avances, resultados, obstáculos y lecciones aprendidas derivadas de las actividades de comunicación para uso interno.
Apoyar la preparación de propuestas de financiamiento y documentos de planificación estratégica.
Gestionar actividades, cronogramas y presupuestos asignados a su área de responsabilidad bajo la supervisión de la Coordinación Regional de Educación Política e Incidencia (PEAC).
Cumplir con las políticas, procedimientos y estándares institucionales de AFSC, incluidas las directrices para el uso de la marca y las normas de confidencialidad de la información.
Elaborar informes de avance del programa para uso interno y externo, así como materiales informativos para donantes y aliados estratégicos.

Licenciatura en Comunicación Social, Periodismo, Ciencias Sociales o áreas afines. Los estudios de posgrado en comunicación estratégica, publicidad/mercadeo, derechos humanos o áreas relacionadas se considerarán una ventaja.

Experiencia en el diseño de estrategias de comunicación locales, nacionales y multinacionales.

description:
About The Role And Team

Uber is about much more than getting a safe and reliable ride from A to B—we’re redefining how people and things move through cities and people connect with their communities. As a Communications Associate, you will be the voice of this transformation, turning complex technological shifts into human stories that resonate with journalists and the public alike. You’ll join a team of high-energy storytellers who manage our reputation across dynamic markets, ensuring that the benefits of our mobility and delivery platforms are front and center in every conversation.

Working in Comms at Uber means moving at the speed of the news cycle in an environment where the stakes are high and the answers aren't always in a playbook. You’ll need to balance proactive campaign building with the grit required to handle reactive, high-profile media inquiries under pressure.

This role is for a self-starter who finds energy in ambiguity and is motivated by the challenge of shaping a narrative that impacts thousands of earners. Earner Comms is a critical bridge between business priorities and tailored earner engagement to help position Uber as the preferred platform.

What You’ll Do


 Own and strengthen earner trust: Identify and elevate credible earner stories across earned media, community channels, and strategic communications initiatives. 
Build relationships: Identify and develop trusted relationships with earners to position Uber as a platform that listens, responds, and delivers meaningful improvement for their experience.
Shape the narrative: Translate Uber’s earner priorities into compelling narratives that can resonate within earners. Strengthen direct communications and engagement through our channels and targeted earner networks. 
Provide feedback: Establish feedback loops with other teams to ensure earner perspectives are reflected in communications strategies and operational improvements.


Basic Qualifications


Bachelor’s Degree
4+ years of professional experience in media relations, journalism, or a corporate communications role.
Exceptional storytelling skills with a proven ability to understand an issue from all sides and advocate for a clear position.
Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to build trust with executives and partners across a global organization.
A creative problem solver who can identify emerging trends and build impactful campaigns from scratch with limited information.


Preferred Qualifications


Experience working in a fast-paced technology or consumer-facing industry where navigating tension and heat is part of the job.
Experience building relationships with communities and creating opportunities for two-way dialogue. Ability to anticipate reputational risks and coordinate timely, accurate and emphatic communications during business or regulatory changes.


Ready to Ride?

This isn't the kind of place where you follow a playbook — it's where you help write one. If you're driven by impact, energized by challenge, and ready to shape how the world moves — we'd love to hear from you.

You may be eligible for bonuses, equity, and other compensation, as well as a range of benefits. Explore our benefits.

About SocialTale

SocialTale is a TikTok Shop specialist agency and official TikTok Shop Agency Partner. We work with DTC brands across the US, UK and EU to grow affiliate-driven GMV through creator recruitment, campaign execution and hands-on shop ops.

Role summary

We are hiring an Affiliate Manager to sit inside a delivery pod and run the creator engine for US TikTok Shop brands. Identify, outreach and onboard creators who fit brand categories and campaign goals (TikTok, Cruva, FastMoss and referrals)

Build and manage active creator relationships: briefing, negotiation, retention and re-warming between launches

Coordinate creator activity around product launches, flash sales and promo windows

Manage sample approvals against brand thresholds and follow through sample-to-post

Track affiliate GMV, activation, video output and conversion; flag what works and cut what does not

Keep creator lists, CRM and tiers accurate; feed a clear weekly affiliate read into pod and client updates

Work with the strategist on briefs, positioning and content direction

Speak with clients on Slack, email and calls when affiliate performance needs explaining

At least 1 year hands-on TikTok Shop experience (affiliate, creator management or shop management)

Fluent English, written and spoken

Confident speaking with clients and creators on calls, not only async

Highly organised; able to run many creator relationships and campaigns at once

Comfortable with performance data and spreadsheets

Strong grasp of TikTok and the creator landscape

Based in Mexico, Brazil or Argentina and able to cover US business hours (Eastern preferred)

Agency experience
